generalRules: Only one promotion can be applied per order.
Promotions apply only to items marked available in the menu.
Discounts are calculated on menu prices, including any size extra cost.
All days and times are in the café's local time.

promotions.name: Morning Coffee & Croissant
promotions.description: Get any hot coffee with a Butter Croissant and save 15% on both items.

discount.appliesTo: One hot coffee and one Butter Croissant per order.

promotions.name: Chai Break: Buy 2, Get 1 Free
promotions.description: Order 3 Karak Chai on a weekday afternoon and the third one is free.

discount.appliesTo: The cheapest of the three Karak Chai is free. Applies once per order.

promotions.name: Big Order Saver
promotions.description: Spend PKR 3,000 or more and get 10% off your whole order.

discount.appliesTo: The whole order total, before any other discount.
